subject: Eval gates & phased signature lanes — sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form
messages:
From: Rachel Young <rachel@sunbridgehealth.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@sunbridgehealth.com
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Eval gates and sequencing — initial plan attached

Hi Sergio / Laura,

Thanks for the demo last week — team is excited about the latency profile you showed. Procurement asked me to share an initial evaluation plan and to align on sequencing for legal (MSA/DPA) vs order form sign-off. I attached SunBridge_EvalPlan_v1.xlsx with the milestones we care about. High-level asks from our side:

- We need SOC 2 evidence and a clear DPA appendix before any production data goes into the pilot.
- Prefer to sign MSA + DPA to get contractual terms locked, then finalize order form after acceptance testing (we call this a staggered-signature approach).
- Can we commit to a 30-day pilot with a single dedicated model instance and explicit rollback criteria?

Questions for you:
1) Can Redwood accept a phased timeline (MSA/DPA first, order form after acceptance)?
2) Any required evidence items you need from our side beyond the SOC2 checklist?
3) Are there model-variant fallbacks (e.g., Core-Lite hosted) we can use if dedicated capacity isn't ready at pilot start?

Target dates in the attachment assume a kickoff week of May 4. Can you and your legal team confirm by end of next week?

Thanks,
Rachel Young
Head of Procurement
SunBridge Health

Attachment: SunBridge_EvalPlan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Rachel Young <rachel@sunbridgehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval gates and sequencing — initial plan attached

Rachel — thanks for the plan and the clear asks. We're aligned on the broad approach and can support a staggered-signature flow. Quick notes and next steps below. I've attached a short gap table (Redwood_MSA_DPA_GapTable.xlsx) showing the few DPA items we prefer to handle in the MSA/DPA and which we can defer to the order form.

Summary answers:
- Phased timeline: yes. We can sign MSA+DPA first to lock security, data handling, and indemnities; order form (pricing/term specifics) can follow post-acceptance.
- Evidence: we can provide SOC2 report summary, control narratives, and a curated evidence bundle for the pilot. The Soc2 evidence request PDF in your attachment looks complete; we'll map responses to the checklist by April 22.
- Model fallbacks: we can provide a hosted "Core-Lite" instance as a fallback for the initial 30-day pilot if dedicated GPU capacity needs more lead time. We'll document performance differences in the MAP.

Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
- Week 1 (May 4): Contract signature (MSA+DPA) — limited data onboarding allowed for non-production testing.
- Week 2–3: Acceptance testing window (pilot run); evidence exchange ongoing.
- Week 4: Order form finalized and signed if acceptance criteria met; production cutover tracked in runbook.

Action items (owners):
- Sergio: Circulate Redwood gap table and draft MAP by EOD Fri (Apr 17).
- Laura: Confirm legal exceptions (if any) to the DPA redlines by Apr 20.
- Karthik: Validate capacity plan for the dedicated instance and confirm earliest provisioning date by Apr 21.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_DPA_GapTable.xlsx (spreadsheet)

I'll follow up with a brief MAP doc and a DocuSign envelope for MSA+DPA if legal signoff is green.

— Sergio Alvarez
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Gina Morales <gina@legaltechlp.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, Rachel Young <rachel@sunbridgehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: DPA redlines + evidence windows (comments)

Forwarding quick comments from our legal partner (cc'd) on DPA items. We can accept most standard obligations but have two asks:

- Request: Add a 45-day cure/notification window for any data-related incidents where remediation depends on third parties.
- Ask: Clarify the data deletion and return language for cached KV cache artifacts used during inference — specify retention < 30 days for pilot.

Quoted for context:
> On Fri, 17 Apr 2026 08:10:00 -0700, LegalTech LP Team wrote:
>
> "We reviewed the DPA language. Narrow redline to the breach notification timing and the technical controls for key material (KMS/HSM). If Redwood provides an optional KMS integration for SunBridge, include that in the MSA appendix and note any operational impacts to latency/cost.
>
> Also recommend an evidence window schedule (weekly evidence drops during pilot, final bundle at acceptance)."

Gina Morales
Senior Counsel, LegalTech LP (external counsel for SunBridge)

Attachment: none (comments inline)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, Rachel Young <rachel@sunbridgehealth.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval gates and sequencing — initial plan attached

Thanks all — quick internal confirmations:

- Legal stance: We can accept a 45-day cure window as a limited exception for the pilot; we'll capture this as a timeboxed deviation in the MSA appendix.
- KMS: We support KMS/HSM integration on the Private deployment path; note that enabling customer-managed KMS may add provisioning lead time (estimate +10 days).
- Retention: We'll commit to <=30 day retention for inference cache artifacts during the pilot and include explicit language in the DPA.

Procurement note to SunBridge procurement: Once MSA+DPA redlines land, please route the DocuSign envelope and we will prioritize countersigning to hit the May 4 kickoff target. If procurement needs a PO in advance, let us know and we'll align timing.

— Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Rachel Young <rachel@sunbridgehealth.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval gates & phased signature lanes — final MAP and next steps

All — putting the mutual action plan in one place. Please treat this as the working MAP; I'll upload a PDF to the deal record after you ack. Key timeline (finalized):

Milestone 0: Legal pre-sprint (Apr 21–23) — review redlines; SunBridge to submit final redlines Apr 22.
Milestone 1: MSA + DPA signature via DocuSign (target Apr 29).
Milestone 2: Pilot provisioning & evidence schedule (May 4–May 31). Weekly evidence drops (Mon) and final bundle on acceptance test completion.
Milestone 3: Order form negotiation & signature (target May 28) — order form can be signed once acceptance gates are green; billing start date effective on sign-off.

Contingencies / fallback lanes:
- If dedicated instance delayed beyond May 4, Redwood will enable a hosted Core-Lite fallback for the pilot with documented perf delta.
- KMS integration: customer-managed KMS moves to Week 2 provisioning (+10 days).

Immediate asks for SunBridge:
1) Send final DPA redlines by Apr 22 so Laura can prepare the DocuSign package.
2) Confirm whether SunBridge procurement will issue a pre-signed PO or wait until order form sign-off.

I'll update the HubSpot deal and attach the MAP + gap table: https://hubspot.company/deal/DEAL-2026-042. DocuSign envelope will be sent once redlines are received: https://docusign.com/embedded?envelopeId=abc123

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

— Sergio
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: SunBridge_EvalPlan_v1.xlsx, Redwood_MSA_DPA_GapTable.xlsx, SunBridge_SOC2_Evidence_Request.pdf
